source: BM Surveying, Inc. — Land Boundary Survey Plat, sheet 1 of 1
scale: 1 inch = 80 feet at original 24 x 36 inch sheet size; screen zoom changes display scale

tracts.description: Owner marks two proposed 200 × 150 ft factories: inverter manufacturing and battery assembly. Positions are conceptual.

Owner-confirmed structures 1 (east), 2 (middle), 3 (west) correspond to A, B and C. A and C provide 5,035 sq ft gross data-center area. B provides 2,083 sq ft for utility, battery and storage; a separate 2,000 sq ft BESS area remains proposed.
Proposed solar development area. Former greenhouse/pad omitted from the proposed overlay as requested; historical source documents remain unchanged.

easements: Proposed 50-foot ingress/egress and utility easements appear on the plat. Obtain recorded documents and current title review.
limitations: This is the supplied survey copy, not a new survey, title opinion, engineering design or construction plan.
The survey notes no benefit of abstract/title opinion and no easement documents provided to the surveyor.
Surveyed structures do not establish present condition, data-center commissioning or permitted use. A/B/C names and current uses are owner-confirmed.
Do not use a screenshot or screen scale for construction staking.
areaBasis: Current legal parcel area supplied by owner 10 September 2026. Historical survey tract annotations total 39.21 acres and are retained without changing geometry.
